programmes.d: A stern mother's wish for a better life for her son stirs his defiance and threatens tragic consequences for his sweetheart. (TV-PG)
Doc suspects the new town doctor of being a charlatan.
Murder and robbery disrupt life in Dodge City when a crooked elixir salesman and his three outlaw sons move in.
Matt tries to save the life of a man dying of gangrene.
An outlaw gang terrorizes Dodge City.
Manolo is not recognized as a man in the eyes of his people because he refuses to fight his father Alejo, a traditional Basque custom to prove one's manhood.
Doc Adams is in jeopardy when he is the only witness to a killing, and the murderer becomes his patient.
Chester finds himself the unwilling guardian and nurse of a runaway Indian who has been befriended by a young white girl.
A runaway girl, fleeing brutal treatment at an orphanage, creates a stir in Dodge City among saloon hangers-on. (TV-PG)
When young Cale gallops out of town on another man's horse, Marshal Dillon goes after him and finds him paralyzed from a fall.
Matt arrests a drifter for robbing and murdering a cattle buyer.
A rancher who has been threatened refuses Matt's help.
A young Indian boy helps redeem an ex-cavalry soldier who was responsible for crippling him during an attack on the boy's village.
A pair of strangers are on Matt's "wanted" list.
A gambler marries an outlaw's widow for her husband's stolen money.
A Scandinavian immigrant and his teenage son find the West even wilder than they had imagined when they settle in Dodge City.
Inspired by the play Romeo and Juliet, the children of feuding family patriarchs fall in love.
Festus is caught in the middle when an Eastern preacher, played by guest star David Wayne, wants to build a church for the Indians and the townspeople, all of whom are filled with prejudice.
Esteban Garcia arrives in Dodge to kill Grave Tabor, who has already been kicked out.
An ex-outlaw offers to help Marshal Dillon track down members of his old gang and talk them out of hiding.
The ambitious wife of a new doctor tries to steal patients away from Doc Adams by spreading rumors that old Doc is an alcoholic.
A two-timing wile brings tragedy to her husband and two infatuated swains and nearly costs Quint Asper his life.

A photographer from the east seeks to immortalize the violent West.
The father of a young gunfighter tries to end his son's career by wounding his gun hand.
A young drifter kidnaps Kitty and holds her captive in a ghost town to lure Doc Adams, Festus, and Matt to the area.
A lonely old man is framed for murder after his life has been saved by a young drifter.
A daring jailbreak reunites a family of vicious outlaws who wound a pursuing U.S. marshal, kid his deputy, then wait in ambush for the injured lawman and Marshal Dillon.
An eccentric transient and his motley offspring bring tragedy to a peace-loving rancher and his family.
A lonely widow takes angry revenge after realizing she has mistaken half-breed Quint Asper's kindness for romantic interest. (TV-PG)
